tips.text: Check your clan tier first; the base cost applies only to a Ghost clan, so remove inactive members or use a Ghost clan.
Join a clan that has already researched Hema, buy the blueprint, and leave; recruiting chat often advertises all research done.
Farm Mutagen Samples for the research, not Mutagen Mass or invasion Mutagen rewards; they do not count.
Start the Mutagen Mass and Torid research timers while you farm samples, then fund Hema in one big session.
Players say the 5,000 Mutagen Samples are the whole grind; everything else is timers and ordinary resources.
Players call the Hema fine but not worth the grind for itself; they do it for the Mastery.
